About.title: Compassionate Healthcare Built on Trust and Excellence
About.paragraph1: At Baghdad Medical Center, we believe that health is life's greatest wealth. Guided by the vision of our founder, Dr. Safaa Mohamed Hussein, we are committed to providing compassionate, patient-centered healthcare through experienced doctors, advanced medical technology, and modern facilities. Every patient is treated with professionalism, respect, and genuine care.
About.missionDesc: To improve the health and well-being of our community by delivering compassionate, accessible, and high-quality healthcare supported by experienced medical professionals, advanced technology, and patient-focused care.
About.visionDesc: To be the trusted healthcare destination for families in Al Madam by combining medical excellence, modern facilities, and continuous innovation in patient care.
About.quote: We believe that health is the greatest wealth a person can possess. Our goal is to help patients achieve the highest levels of health and well-being, and we work diligently to create a supportive and dedicated environment in their service.

FAQ.title: Common Questions
FAQ.description: Answers to what patients ask us most.

support.title: Can't find your answer?
support.description: Our reception team is ready to help you with anything you need. Reach out to us directly.

item1.question: Do I need an appointment?
item1.answer: Walk-ins are welcome, but booking ahead guarantees your preferred time slot with minimal wait time.

item2.question: What are your working hours?
item2.answer: We are open Saturday through Thursday from {satOpen} to {satClose}, and Friday from {friOpen} to {friBreak} and {friReturn} to {friClose}.

item3.question: Do you accept insurance?
item3.answer: Yes — we partner with major providers including NextCare, AlMadallah, Al-Buhaira, Neuron, FMC, and Life Line.

item4.question: What should I bring for my first visit?
item4.answer: Please bring a valid Emirates ID and your digital or physical insurance card (if applicable).

item5.question: Does insurance cover laser, cosmetic, or Hijama (cupping) treatments?
item5.answer: No. Insurance covers core consultations and treatments in General Medicine, Dermatology, Dentistry, and Gynecology. Laser, skincare, and Hijama services are direct-pay only.

item6.question: Do you offer Hijama (cupping therapy) and laser treatments?
item6.answer: Yes, we provide professional Hijama (cupping therapy), cosmetic laser treatments, and advanced skincare procedures.

item7.question: What medical specialties do you offer?
item7.answer: We offer General Medicine, Dentistry, Dermatology, Obstetrics & Gynecology, Pediatrics, and internal diagnostics.

item8.question: Do you offer lab testing and diagnostics on-site?
item8.answer: Yes, our facility includes an on-site laboratory for routine blood work and essential diagnostic services.
